main_conclusions: ScaleInitStrategy without a local torch.Generator is an important codebook initialization RNG source, but codebook_init_seed alone is not a sufficient stable solution.

The final mechanism is early basin selection through codebook/address/projection joint geometry and routing/write/read/M/lambda feedback; the first explainable normal high/low split is at step 353-448.
Default phase2 read_topk=2 is a basin amplifier; it can lock early residual reads to a too narrow candidate set.
Phase2 read_topk=4 is validated on cb256-r4/cb256-r8, but cross-codebook/rank replication shows it is not a global default.
The design lesson is controlled read-side candidate coverage with schedule/gate/margin awareness, not larger read_topk in general or stronger early lambda injection.
counterexamples: read_topk=8 gives s124 1ep step705=0.079113, showing wider read coverage is not monotonic.
read_topk=4 with lambda_init=0.15 gives s124 1ep step705=0.428566, showing stronger early injection is not sufficient.
fixed codebook seed and preserve-RNG variants do not produce a cross-seed stable solution.
caveats: Historical pseudo-det 0.951/0.952 values are valid 1024x256 metrics but not ordinary normal training baselines.
cross-cb64r16-readk2-s124-r1 is a CUDA OOM failed run and is excluded from formal spread; cross-cb64r16-readk2-s124-r1b is the valid replacement.
Formal readk4 metrics are rounded to the precision logged by the training loop.
Large raw logs, checkpoints, and swanlog backups are kept in place; this artifact stores final tables and source references only.
No source default was changed in this artifact update.
cross_config_conclusions: Fixed phase2 read_topk=4 is not a cross-configuration default solution.
cb256-r8 validates readk4 as effective: readk2 spread 0.184, readk4 completed-run max-min spread 0.010, worst 0.982.
cb64-r16 is a side-effect counterexample: readk4 s124 r1/r2 are 0.831/0.849 versus readk2 s124 0.959.
cb128-r8 is a reproducibility counterexample: readk4 main pair 0.973/0.972, but s125 rerun final 0.609.
The recommended direction is schedule/gate/margin-aware read-side control rather than a fixed global readk4 default.
